pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

updates.content:
🛡️ $BUNKER — Bunker Mode: Your Wallet Can’t Open the Vault
AGI steals keys. Drainers trick signatures. Quantum might break curves one day.
Bunker Mode is a separate Solana vault where your everyday wallet can only deposit — it has zero authority to withdraw. A different, one-time hash-based key is required to take anything out.
Why it stands out:
🔐 True key separation: Wallet pays fees and deposits. A day key (one-time LM-OTS / SHA-256 signatures) announces withdrawals. Recovery kit (kept offline) can cancel pending moves or replace keys. A stolen seed or drainer signature can’t empty the vault.
⏱️ Built-in protection: Up to 4 trusted addresses for instant withdrawals + optional waiting period (you choose) on everything else, giving you time to cancel with the recovery kit.
🔓 Open source & transparent: Live public beta on Solana mainnet. Program is a verified build. CertiK audit commissioned. Active bug bounty (funded by $BUNKER creator rewards). Bunker Watch Chrome extension alerts you the second a withdrawal is announced.
Trade from a hot wallet. Sweep what you want to keep into a Bunker. One bad click no longer costs you everything.
Early-stage token (launched on pump.fun, still low MC, high volatility). The real product is the vault tech — the coin is community fuel for development and bounties.

🌐 bunkermode.io | 🐦 @BunkerModeIO
NFA. DYOR. Public beta, unaudited until the report drops — start small, only risk what you can afford to lose.
